  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Makeup Examination - June -2024  
  Bio-Informatics [CSE-4012]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           With a schematic diagram discuss the constituent components of the UniProt Database  
  and also elaborate on the six steps involved in the UniProtKB manual curation process  
  (4)  
  in protein synthesis in reference to Swiss-Prot.  
  A)  
  B)      Distinguish between primary databases and derivative databases in the context of  
  Biological databases by giving at least two examples for each. Discuss any four features (4)  
  of the RefSeq Nucleotide Databases  
  
  C)      Determine the highest matched score for aligning AGTCTAG with AGATTCGAG by  
  keeping the mismatches and gaps to the minimum using a simple nucleotide alignment            (2)  
  strategy.  
  
  2)           Justify with at least three valid reasons for the need to align biological sequences  
  pertaining to genetic nucleotides and proteins. Discuss at least three applications where  
  the alignment of genetic sequences has proven beneficial to humankind and society at          (4)  
  A)      large.  
  
  B)      Interpret the significance and working of ProDom, SMART,RPS-BLAST, and CDART  
  in the context of integration of biological databases, statistical models, and other tools    (4)  
  for multiple sequence alignment.  
  
  C)      Illustrate the functionalities of PROSITE and EMotif in carrying out multiple sequence  
  alignment.                                                                                    (2)  
  
  3)           Discuss Block-Based Alignment by citing DIALIGN2 and Match-Box. Highlighting the  
  need for Motifs for Protein Alignment, interpret how Regular Expressions are required  
  (4)  
  for the correlation of Motifs and Domain Databases during synthesis of proteins.  
  A)  
  B)      "Molecular Phylogenetics involves the derivation of Phylogenetic tree at a Genetic  
  Level". Discuss any two Clustering-Based methods for the construction of a                    (4)  
  Phylogenetic tree.  
  
  C)      Interpret the primary objective of the GOR Algorithm in the context of secondary  
  structure prediction.                                                                         (2)  
  
  4)           With an illustration using a flow diagram, discuss the steps in detail, the Homology          (5)
